intro: Over the past month, ZCyberNews has tracked 33 articles tagged with ai, covering activity from 8 April to 5 May 2026. The threat actors Bluekit and Pushpaganda were the most frequently reported, with high-severity incidents dominating the severity mix alongside one critical alert. The technology and financial services sectors were the most affected, while the global region, along with the United Kingdom, United States, Asia, and Australia, saw the greatest impact.
